## Configuration

See [Configuration](/basics/configuration/).

| Export | Kind | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`defineBot()`](/reference/define-bot/) | Function | Creates a `Bot`. |
| [`env()`](/reference/env/) | Function | Reads an environment variable, with an optional fallback. |
| [`isBot()`](/reference/is-bot/) | Function | Robust, cross-realm check that a value is a `Bot` - use this instead of `instanceof`, which breaks across the CJS/ESM dual-package boundary. |
| [`loadEnvFile()`](/reference/load-env-file/) | Function | Loads a `.env` file into `process.env`. |
| [`Bot`](/reference/bot/) | Class | The bot application. |
| [`BotConfig`](/reference/bot-config/) | Interface | The full bot configuration object. |
| [`BotDescription`](/reference/bot-description/) | Interface | A structured description of everything the bot has loaded. |
| [`BotStats`](/reference/bot-stats/) | Interface | A snapshot of the runtime counters, as returned by `Bot.stats`. |
| [`DeployCallOptions`](/reference/deploy-call-options/) | Interface | Options for `Bot.deploy`. |
| [`DeployConfig`](/reference/deploy-config/) | Interface | Deployment configuration. |

## Guards

See [Guards](/commands/guards/).

| Export | Kind | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`anyOf()`](/reference/any-of/) | Function | Passes when **at least one** of the given guards passes. |

| [`hasRole()`](/reference/has-role/) | Function | Requires the invoking member to hold **at least one** of the given roles. |
| [`inChannel()`](/reference/in-channel/) | Function | Restricts usage to specific channel ids. |
| [`inGuild()`](/reference/in-guild/) | Function | Requires the interaction to happen inside a guild. |
| [`not()`](/reference/not/) | Function | Inverts a guard: passes when it fails. |
| [`ownerOnly()`](/reference/owner-only/) | Function | Restricts usage to specific user ids. |
| [`pass()`](/reference/pass/) | Function | Signals a guard passed. |
| [`Guard`](/reference/guard-interface/) | Interface | A named, composable precondition. |
| [`GuardResult`](/reference/guard-result/) | Interface | The outcome of a guard check. |
| [`CooldownScope`](/reference/cooldown-scope/) | Type | Cooldown scope. |
| [`GuardFn`](/reference/guard-fn/) | Type | A guard's check function. |

## Deploying commands

See [Deploying commands](/production/deploying/).

| Export | Kind | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`buildCommandTree()`](/reference/build-command-tree/) | Function | Builds the full desired command tree (ignoring per-command scoping). |
| [`clearCommands()`](/reference/clear-commands/) | Function | Removes **all** of the app's commands from one scope (a guild, or global). |
| [`commandsEqual()`](/reference/commands-equal/) | Function | Whether a local command and the one Discord returned describe the same thing. |
| [`commandToJSON()`](/reference/command-to-json/) | Function | Converts one slash command definition to the REST JSON body Discord expects. |
| [`deployCommands()`](/reference/deploy-commands/) | Function | Deploys commands, honouring per-command scoping: - commands with no `guilds` go **global**, - commands with `guilds` go to **those guilds**. |
| [`planDeployment()`](/reference/plan-deployment/) | Function | Partitions the registry's commands into a global set and per-guild sets based on each command's `guilds` field. |
| [`ClearOptions`](/reference/clear-options/) | Interface | Options for `clearCommands`. |
| [`DeploymentPlan`](/reference/deployment-plan/) | Interface | A resolved deployment plan: which commands go global, and which go to which guild. |
| [`DeployOptions`](/reference/deploy-options/) | Interface | Options for `deployCommands`. |
| [`DeployResult`](/reference/deploy-result/) | Interface | The outcome of a deploy across all targets. |
| [`DeployTargetResult`](/reference/deploy-target-result/) | Interface | What changed for one deploy target (global, or a specific guild). |

## Resilience

| Export | Kind | What it is for |

| [`rateLimit()`](/reference/rate-limit/) | Function | A guard that allows `limit` uses per `window`, per scope (default `"user"`). |

| [`RetryOptions`](/reference/retry-options/) | Interface | Options for `retry`. |
